name: hover-card
title: Hover Card
description: More about a link while the pointer rests on it: the card's #262626 fill, a hairline and the brand corner. The pointer can cross into it; on touch the link just works.
use_for: A preview of a brand, a creator or a board named in text, with a few numbers. The link must lead to the same thing on its own.
never: The only way to reach what it shows: the link must work on its own
Actions someone has to take: use Popover or Dropdown Menu
A shadow or a glow: the fill and the hairline set it apart
source: Derived from the brand guidelines (no hover card in the brand assets): the plan card's #262626 fill and corner, the neutral steps for the hairline
